# Thermal

> Don't break the streak. High-performance terminal contribution heatmap and leaderboard tool for AI coding assistants.

Thermal scans local databases and session transcripts across 15 AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, OpenCode, Codex, Grok, Agy, DeepSeek DSH, Nous Hermes, MiMoCode, codewhale, ZCode, Muse, Droid, command-code, Zed), aggregates tokens and cost metrics, and renders beautiful terminal heatmaps and reports.

- Canonical Site: https://jadmadi.net/project/thermal/
- Repository: https://github.com/jadmadi/thermal
- Full Specification: https://jadmadi.net/project/thermal/llms-full.txt
- Migration Guide: https://jadmadi.net/project/thermal/migration

## Quickstart & Installation

```bash
# Homebrew (macOS & Linux)
brew install jadmadi/tap/thermal

# Standalone Shell Installer (Linux & macOS)
curl -fsSL https://jadmadi.net/thermal/install.sh | sh

# Go Toolchain
go install github.com/jadmadi/thermal/cmd/thermal@latest
```

## Supported AI Coding Tools

- **Claude Code** (`claude`): Scans `~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl` for assistant message usage.
- **Devin** (`devin`): Queries SQLite DB joining `message_nodes` against `sessions`.
- **OpenCode** (`opencode`): Reads `session_v2` and legacy tables with pre-aggregated tokens.
- **Codex CLI** (`codex`): Reads `state_5.sqlite` supplemented with rollout JSONL logs.
- **Grok** (`grok`): Scans `~/.grok/sessions/*/*/updates.jsonl` with turn deduplication.
- **DeepSeek Harness** (`dsh`): Scans `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json`.
- **Nous Hermes** (`hermes`): Reads `~/.hermes/state.db` with memory-mapped SQLite.
- **Agy / Antigravity** (`agy`): Scans `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/*/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl`.
- **MiMoCode** (`mimocode`): SQLite pre-aggregated tokens and session directories.
- **codewhale** (`codewhale`): Reads `~/.codewhale/sessions/*.json`.
- **ZCode** (`zcode`): Reads `~/.zcode/cli/db/db.sqlite` completed model usage.
- **command-code** (`command-code`): Scans `~/.commandcode/projects/*/*.jsonl`; per-assistant usage, recorded cost, per-message models, and project `cwd`.
- **Muse** (`muse`): Reads `~/.local/share/muse/session-index.db` prompt counts.
- **Droid** (`droid`): Scans `~/.factory/sessions/*/*.jsonl` message records.

## Core Commands

- `thermal`: All-tools contribution leaderboard.
- `thermal [tool] daily`: Daily tokens, cost, and turn activity (`--last N`, `--since`, `--until`).
- `thermal [tool] weekly`: Weekly activity overview (`--chart` for ASCII bars).
- `thermal [tool] monthly`: Monthly rollup table.
- `thermal projects`: Token and cost distribution aggregated by git repository root.
- `thermal models`: Token breakdown and estimated cost per model.
- `thermal mix`: Switching statistics and usage mix (`--by tool|model`, `--grain day|week|month`).
- `thermal stats`: Daily percentile distribution, weekday seasonality, and outliers.
- `thermal trend`: Daily linear trend fit with month-end token projection.
- `thermal upgrade`: Self-update binary in place to the latest GitHub release.
- `thermal license`: AGPLv3 terms, Community Reciprocity Covenant, the $30/developer/year Commercial Use License, and Enterprise & OEM terms.

## Machine-Readable Output

Every report command supports `--json` for scripting and pipelines:

```bash
thermal weekly --json
thermal projects --top 10 --json
thermal license --json
```
